import sys
from collections import defaultdict, deque

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    idx = 0
    n = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
    m = int(input_data[idx]); idx += 1
    
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    
    for _ in range(n):
        ns = input_data[idx]; idx += 1
        ew = input_data[idx]; idx += 1
        graph[ns].append(ew)
    
    out_lines = []
    for _ in range(m):
        s1 = input_data[idx]; idx += 1
        s2 = input_data[idx]; idx += 1
        
        # BFS to see if s1 -> s2
        visited = set()
        q = deque([s1])
        visited.add(s1)
        found = False
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if u == s2:
                found = True
                break
            for v in graph[u]:
                if v not in visited:
                    visited.add(v)
                    q.append(v)
        out_lines.append("Y" if found else "N")
    
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out_lines))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
